question: Annotate variants.vcf using VEP with vep_custom.vcf.gz as a custom annotation source, adding CSQ annotations to the INFO field.

files.eval_guideline: Variant records must carry CSQ annotations in the INFO field with InCancerDB custom annotations applied; exact CSQ subfield values and ordering may differ; header lines may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Both files are named variants_vep.vcf and are VCFs, so the name and format match exactly. Both are the VEP-annotated version of variants.vcf.
files.strategy_reasoning: VEP annotation is deterministic and keeps the input variant records, but the guideline allows CSQ subfield values, their order and headers to differ, so exact is too strict. Record-level approximate matching with no position slack pairs each variant with its reference so CSQ and InCancerDB annotations can be checked.
